card.name: Start of a split proper name
card.fires_on: Short first pieces of a name or title that is split across tokens, such as a single capital letter or 'Inv' or '-L', where the rest of the name follows in the next piece.

modes.label: Split personal names
modes.description: A letter or short piece begins a surname or given name after a first name or initial.

modes.label: Split trial or study names
modes.description: A '-L' piece inside a hyphenated trial or author name, just before 'ung' or 'inden'.

modes.label: Split place or spell names
modes.description: A short opening piece of a place or invented name.

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted tokens are scattered words about tears and emotion, and the suppressed ones are broken-character pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the first small piece of an uncommon name that the model has to read in several parts.
